## Scope check

- [ ] This could be a **tool** (`backend/luxion/tools/builtin/`) — the most common shape of a contribution
- [ ] This could be a **web/data source** (`backend/luxion/web/`) — must be keyless
- [ ] This needs a **new Python dependency** — please say which, and why the standard library cannot do it
- [ ] This touches **hardware** (camera, mic, screen, keyboard, terminal) — a capability gate is required
- [ ] This is **UI only**
